<thought>The carbon NMR shows four signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–55 ppm): 19.23 ppm (alkyl CH₃), 52.24 ppm (O‑CH₃), 49.55 ppm and 43.55 ppm (both could correspond to N‑CH₃ or other methyl environments). Each distinct methyl carbon gives a separate signal, so the molecule contains four CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
